name: Oh That's Why English
style: clean hand-drawn 2D editorial illustration, explainer-video style, bold simple shapes, soft flat colours with gentle grain texture, crisp dark outlines, one consistent palette for every scene: warm cream background, charcoal outlines, teal and soft orange accents, simple uncluttered background, clear single subject, not a photo, not 3D render, vertical composition, leave the top third uncluttered for a title
voice_note: Stock Gemini voice in 'voices'. 'voice_trial' (Prashant's cloned voice) overrides it while running/kept.

voice_trial.name: clone
voice_trial.note: KEPT 2026-11-15 by the owner's choice (trial ended early): every English video uses Prashant's cloned voice. Only the owner changes this; the script run never reverts it. If the clone fails at render, that video falls back to the stock voice in 'voices'.

delivery_note: Scene 'delivery' is one of: warm, curious, lean-in, build, reveal, light, serious (factory/tts.py DELIVERY). Keep styles short: Google says long style text makes the voice drift.

engagement.note: Prashant 2026-11-13: hook people in the first ~2 s and keep them (open loop, mid re-hook, late payoff); end every video with a guess about TOMORROW's topic; the first 3 right answers (across YouTube, Instagram, Facebook) get their names on screen in the next video. Checked by factory/render.py check_engagement; names picked by factory/quiz.py at render time.
engagement.quiz_note: Prashant 2026-11-21: (1) the answer was B every day, so the right letter moves around (render refuses the same letter 3 videos running); (2) the quiz card was on screen too briefly, so it is held 9 s (min 7 s) and the narration reads the question out; (3) EXPERIMENT from 2026-11-21: the quiz is a light pop-culture / current-affairs / general-knowledge question anyone can have a go at, NOT about tomorrow's topic (tomorrow's topic is still teased on the card as 'NEXT VIDEO'). Compare comments per video against before. 2026-11-23: GLOBAL, not India-first: questions anyone in the US, UK, Europe, India or Australia has a fair shot at (world films, music, Olympics/World Cup-level sport, space, world landmarks, science). Card held 7 s (min 6 s) so the whole video fits in 65 s.

max_seconds.note: Whole video incl. the quiz hold. Data 2026-11-22: Instagram gives every Reel ~100-230 test views and only pushes past that when skip <=~34% and people watch ~17 s+; the only 2 that broke out were 43 s and 54 s. 50-70 s videos: median 1,476 views vs 818 for 70 s+.

share_ask.note: Sends per reach is one of Instagram's most important ranking signals (Mosseri); our median shares are 0 per 1k. One specific 'send this to the friend who...' line right after the reveal, and as caption line 3.

youtube_brand.note: factory/yt_seo.py puts this on the YouTube channel (About text, keywords) and on every Short (brand line, tags, language) so people searching the channel name find it. Run the 'YouTube channel search' workflow after changing it.
youtube_brand.name: Oh That's Why
youtube_brand.channel_description:
Oh That's Why: everyday things explained in under a minute.

You see these things every day and never think twice about them. The brush on the escalator. The tiny hole in a pen cap. The little pocket in your jeans.

Every video takes one of them and shows you the real reason it’s there. Under a minute, no boring lectures, just “oh, that’s why!”

New Short every day.

Got something you’ve always wondered about? Drop it in the comments and it might be our next video.

Prefer Hindi? Watch us at @ohthatswhy.hindii
youtube_brand.video_line: Oh That's Why: one everyday mystery explained, every day.

style_note: 2026-11-23: back to the 12-18 Nov illustration style (soft flat colours, cream background). The bold saturated style from 19 Nov had median 24 h views 762 vs 1,295 and Instagram seconds falling 11.4 -> 6.9 s.

instagram_trend_audio.note: Instagram Audio API: at posting time the top trending licensed track (GET /ig_audio, no search_query) is attached muted (audio_volume 0, our voice 100), so the Reel also lists under that sound. If Instagram refuses it, the Reel posts with its own sound. The chosen track is saved in state platforms.instagram.audio.

slot_note: 2026-11-23 (owner): global page, so posts go out at 23:30 IST = 18:00 UTC = 6 PM UK / 7 PM Central Europe / 1 PM US East / 10 AM US West, while India is still in its late-night scroll. Was 19:00 IST (8:30 AM US East, 1:30 PM UK). From slot_since the render uses this slot whatever the job or pitch doc says.
